invariants.rationale: The method operates on the provided TiledMap map, so it is expected (and usually required) to be non-null.
The method immediately dereferences tile via tile.getObjects() and tile.getTextureRegion(), so tile must be non-null for the method to function.
The method appears to use the element parameter as a required input to load object data, so it is expected to be non-null.
The method calls tile.getTextureRegion().getRegionHeight(); thus, tile.getTextureRegion() should be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
tile.getObjects() is passed to another method; it should be non-null unless the downstream method can handle null.
